subject: Social Media
title: Cyberbullying Among Youth
description: A 60-second lesson on Cyberbullying Among Youth.

hook.text: A 13-year-old is mocked in a group chat. She can't escape—the bullies are in her phone, her bed, her dreams.

buildup.text: 37% of teens face cyberbullying. Unlike schoolyard bullying, it follows them home and through the night.

discovery.text: Anonymity emboldens cruelty. Kids say things online they'd never say in person. The screen erases empathy.

twist.text: Parents can't see encrypted chats. Schools can't discipline what happens at home. Nobody has authority.

climax.text: Teen suicide rates rose 57% from 2007-2018. Researchers link the spike directly to smartphone adoption.

punchline.text: The bully goes home. Cyberbullying doesn't.

quiz.question: What percentage of teens report experiencing cyberbullying?
